recentItems.title: Chitti - The Little Chitti's Story
recentItems.description:
“Chitti” is a heartwarming and playful new song composed by the legendary Prayagra Ranganadasa the maternal grandfather of the legendary Carnatic maestro Dr. M. Balamuralikrishna 

This song which has been lovingly sung by generations of mothers to amuse and soothe their little ones . At its core, the song paints a tender portrait of a mischievous girl, Chitti, whose lighthearted antics are balanced by the loving care of her mother. Sung by me, beautifully arranged by Karthik Kodakandla. The song is brought to life through the heartfelt acting of Deepthi and her daughter Nyra, with a visually stunning short film, produced by Pradeep and Together, we invite you to experience this joyful and nostalgic journey—one where childhood wonder and maternal love meet in harmony.”

Composer: Shri Prayāga Rangadāsan
Vocal: Anjana Sowmya
Music Arrangement: Karthik Kodakandla
Featuring: Deepthi & Baby Nyra
Video Production: Pradeep 
Post-Production: Srikanth

recentItems.title: ShriRama navami2026 #sriramanavami #carnaticmusic #tyagaraja #ramabhakti #devotional
recentItems.description:
On the auspicious occasion of Sri Rama Navami, I offer this humble musical tribute with the beautiful kriti Sri Raghuvara Aprameya, composed by the great saint-composer Tyagaraja.

Set in the majestic Kambhoji and rendered in Adi Tala, this timeless composition glorifies Lord Rama, the noble descendant of the Raghu dynasty. The kriti beautifully reflects Tyagaraja’s deep devotion and surrender to Rama, capturing the grandeur, compassion, and divine grace of the Lord.

Every time this composition is sung, it carries us back to the sacred musical tradition of Carnatic music where devotion, melody, and rhythm come together as an offering. Presenting this rendition with reverence and gratitude, remembering the immortal legacy of Tyagaraja and the spiritual depth of his compositions.

May the blessings of Lord Rama bring peace, strength, and harmony to all.

🙏 Sri Rama Jayam
